citation: Ontiveros et al. 2023, Nat. Commun., doi:10.1038/s41467-023-41685-w (FOAM set-up reused); deposit by Pohl, Zenodo 10610771
what_it_contains: Three netCDF climate fields (atmosphere 27 MB, coupled 22 MB, ocean 124 MB) of a FOAM general-circulation-model simulation for 440 Ma (Hirnantian); file names carry '840ppm' and 'EccN'.
relevance_note: The only Palaeozoic land-surface climate field (atmosphere) in the register: usable as a boundary condition for spore dispersal and moisture belts at one Late Ordovician time slice, and as a check on Scotese/PhanDA maps. Single slice at a stated CO2 of 840 ppm (from the file names; the paper was not read). [relevance: extractor's inference]

what_it_contains: Model code and outputs (182 netCDF files; model.zip 2.5 GB) coupling an eco-evolutionary vegetation model, a geologic carbon-cycle model and a lookup of PlaSim climate runs, for large-igneous-province CO2 degassing on present-day, Paleocene-Eocene, Triassic-Jurassic and Permian-Triassic geographies; plus a temperature-proxy analysis (MATLAB, Stan).
relevance_note: A working example of the loop F5 wants (vegetation <-> carbon cycle <-> climate on a palaeogeography) with dispersal and niche-adaptation rates as parameters; also the only coupled LIP-degassing model in the register for F6 perturbations. Scenarios are Mesozoic-Cenozoic, so geography and CO2 inputs would need replacing. [relevance: extractor's inference]

citation: Rogger et al. 2026, Geosci. Model Dev., doi:10.5194/gmd-19-4931-2026
what_it_contains: TREED v1.0 (Trait Ecology and Evolution over Deep time): Julia code for a trait- and optimality-based vegetation model with lagged eco-evolutionary dynamics; case studies for present-day validation, the PETM and eco-evolutionary lags (climate inputs are a separate Zenodo record, doi:10.5281/zenodo.17777278, not mirrored). Licence: Zenodo says CC BY 4.0, LICENSE.txt says Apache 2.0.
relevance_note: Closest existing code precedent for evolving vegetation traits on a climate field over deep time; a template for the plant module in F5/F7 and for trait evolution and dispersal limits in F2. Not Palaeozoic, and not leafless axes. [relevance: extractor's inference]

what_it_contains: R code (functions, analyses and figures) and data files (tar.gz) showing where coverage-based rarefaction fails to estimate relative richness.
relevance_note: Sampling-standardisation caveats for any stage-level richness series F3 builds from PBDB and spore compilations. [relevance: extractor's inference]

citation: Balembois et al. 2025, Nat. Commun., doi:10.1038/s41467-025-63428-9
what_it_contains: HadCM3BL-M2.1aD monthly sea-surface temperature fields at 109 time slices (541-0 Ma, one netCDF each), cGENIE BIOGEM climate fields every 20 Myr under two tropical-SST scenarios plus 30 slices with alternative palaeogeography, MATLAB model and figure code.
relevance_note: Stage-resolved palaeoclimate fields on the PALEOMAP maps, 21 of them in the window (SST on the ocean grid, so the land/ocean mask is implicit; the cGENIE files also hold surface air temperature, humidity and precipitation at 36 x 36). Marine-biodiversity paper, so use only as climate boundary conditions. [relevance: extractor's inference]

what_it_contains: DeepDive software, worked marine and proboscidean analyses with trained models, and simulation analyses (613 tables, 9.9 million rows).
relevance_note: Simulation-trained estimator of diversity through time from incomplete occurrence records: a competitor/complement to the birth-death and range-based estimators F3 would validate, with simulated-record machinery that could be reused. [relevance: extractor's inference]

what_it_contains: R scripts and inputs (25.5 MB zip): graptoloid first and last appearances and randomised range-slope files for the Ordovician and Silurian, high-resolution extinction and origination rates, phyletic sensitivity tests.
relevance_note: High-resolution marine extinction/origination series through the Hirnantian and the Silurian events (Ireviken, Mulde, Lau) as an event calendar for F6, and a worked example of rate inference from FA/LA data. Graptoloids, not plants. [relevance: extractor's inference]

what_it_contains: Code archive (7z, not opened by EPRP) and supplement PDF for a dissection of the paleocontinental and paleoenvironmental dynamics of the Great Ordovician Biodiversification.
relevance_note: In-window analysis that ties diversification to palaeocontinent configuration and environment: precedent for linking dispersal and palaeogeography to richness through the Ordovician. [relevance: extractor's inference]

citation: Freitas et al. 2024, J. Evol. Biol., doi:10.1093/jeb/voae035 (deposit version of 2026)
what_it_contains: Simulation materials (tar.gz, not inventoried by EPRP) and a README for patch biogeography under intermittent dispersal barriers.
relevance_note: Individual-based simulation of how barrier intermittency shapes differentiation and speciation: a method precedent for F4 provinciality. Taxon-agnostic; not examined further. [relevance: extractor's inference]

what_it_contains: R code and sedflux forward-stratigraphic-model inputs (one zip, 0.2 MB).
relevance_note: Forward stratigraphic modelling of how sequence stratigraphy shifts apparent range ends is a ready template for the observation layer of F3 (first appearances in a marine/terrestrial rock record). [relevance: extractor's inference]

what_it_contains: PBDB occurrences with rotated palaeocoordinates (dat_rotated.csv, 264 MB), distance-to-track and model tables, a stage table with regimes and hyperthermal flags (massext_tab.csv), PALEOMAP rotation file, Kocsis et al. isolated-coastline rasters for 110 PALEOMAP maps, R and Rmd code.
relevance_note: Stage-resolved palaeogeographic dispersal metrics (coastline isolation, distance to track) computed on the PALEOMAP maps that match paleodem_slices.csv; the isolated-coastline GeoTIFFs for the 21 window maps are a ready geography layer. Observed: its rotation file (PALEOMAP_PlateModel.rot.txt) is byte-identical to the PALEOMAP rotation file in the GPlates index (sha256 prefix d56846bb3c626080), i.e. the same model as the paleomap and scotese_and_wright2018 entries. [relevance: extractor's inference]

citation: Stigall et al. 2026, Palaeogeogr. Palaeoclimatol. Palaeoecol., doi:10.1016/j.palaeo.2026.114134
what_it_contains: Specimen list, morphological characters, measurement workbooks, Nexus matrices and a Bergstrom et al. (2009) stage-slice temporal framework for three Laurentian brachiopod lineages in the Great Ordovician Biodiversification Event; trees as TIFF and PDF.
relevance_note: In-window (Darriwilian-Katian) phylodynamic analysis from morphology with a stage-slice time frame: a worked example of origination inference from an incomplete record, and of Laurentian biogeography. Marine brachiopods, not plants. [relevance: extractor's inference]

what_it_contains: PBDB download of 2022-05-23 (712,947 non-chordate animal occurrences x 126 columns, group files) and analysis code, on marine animal diversity across latitudinal and temperature gradients through the Phanerozoic. Contains PBDB records that PBDB now withholds (EPRP flag).
relevance_note: Method precedent for latitudinal diversity against palaeotemperature; the companion code record also bundles plate-model reconstructions and a climate-model field. Marine animals; withheld-record caveat applies. [relevance: extractor's inference]

licence: Springer Nature TDM licence (Crossref; not open access); held privately under Barry's 23 October 2026 mirroring decision
what_it_contains: Table S1 (108 carbonate samples, delta-7Li) and the supplementary PDF; Springer Nature TDM licence, not open access, held privately under Barry's 23 October decision.
relevance_note: Weathering-proxy (Li isotope) data for the end-Permian; outside the window and not redistributable, so only a method pointer for reverse weathering in F5. [relevance: extractor's inference]

citation: Benson et al. 2025, Palaeontology, doi:10.1111/pala.70006 (Zenodo lists Close first)
what_it_contains: Same PBDB download as the Dryad record, PaleoReefs downloads (4,332 reefs), plate-model reconstructions (99,852 rows), climate-model fields (gcm_data_df.rda, 241 MB) and code with a bundled renv library (46,914 zip members).
relevance_note: Holds a palaeoclimate model field and rotated coordinates per stage, which could serve as a cross-check on the climate layers; same caveats as the Dryad record (do not count as a second PBDB vintage). [relevance: extractor's inference]

citation: Cermeño et al. 2022, Nature, doi:10.1038/s41586-022-04932-6 (INDITEK code by García-Comas)
what_it_contains: INDITEK MATLAB model, gridded inputs (point ages, food and temperature; 127 MB) and fossil diversity series.
relevance_note: Individual-based eco-evolutionary model run on palaeoclimate grids through the Phanerozoic: an architecture precedent for F7 (marine; temperature and food as drivers). [relevance: extractor's inference]

what_it_contains: Fossil and contemporary trait data, grid-search results and metadata (tab-delimited text).
relevance_note: Links evolvability under fluctuating selection to macroevolutionary rates; a possible test of simulated trait change rates. Not plants. [relevance: extractor's inference]

what_it_contains: paleoTS time series (771 files, also RData) and a 771-row summary.
relevance_note: Reference set of fossil trait time series with model-fit results (stasis versus random walk) for judging whether a plant size series is informative. Not plants. [relevance: extractor's inference]

citation: Kocsis et al. 2018, Proc. R. Soc. B, doi:10.1098/rspb.2018.0232
what_it_contains: PBDB downloads of 2017-07-07 for eight marine groups, a Fossilworks collection table, stage tables, shapefiles and R code.
relevance_note: Stage-resolved biogeographic structure (provinciality) across mass extinctions: method precedent for F4's similarity matrices. Marine; withheld-record caveat applies. [relevance: extractor's inference]

what_it_contains: Growth rates (7,708 rows), thermal-performance parameters, a calibrated tree, R and Python code.
relevance_note: Thermal performance curves for photosynthetic microbes; an empirical anchor for temperature-dependent niches of non-vascular primary producers (F6). Phytoplankton, not land plants. [relevance: extractor's inference]

citation: Liu, Penn & Deutsch 2026, no paper found by Crossref on 23 October (EPRP); Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.18217914
what_it_contains: Six MATLAB figure-data files (7.6 MB). Observed variables: CESM-type ocean grids, temperature, PhanSST proxy values and ages; no variable named for atmospheric O2 or CO2.
relevance_note: Marine productivity and oxygenation under Phanerozoic climate; not an atmospheric O2 or CO2 series, so it does not fill those gaps (inference from variable names). [relevance: extractor's inference]

what_it_contains: Extracted climate-model values (462,854 rows), intrinsic and extrinsic variables (22,221 rows) and genus body sizes (9,460 rows) for marine genera.
relevance_note: Climate-model values by stage joined to extinction risk; method precedent for F6 climate-dependent vulnerability. Marine; the climate values were not checked for the window. [relevance: extractor's inference]

citation: Padfield et al. 2016, Ecol. Lett., doi:10.1111/ele.12545
what_it_contains: Thermal performance curves (974 rows), growth curves (324 rows) and metadata for Chlorella.
relevance_note: Same role as kontopoulos2020: a green-alga thermal response dataset. [relevance: extractor's inference]

citation: cGENIE.muffin, Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.23420890 (v0.9.78, 16 October 2026, MIT; the v0.9.35 release of January 2023 is also mirrored)
what_it_contains: Earth-system model code (ocean, atmosphere, sediments, biogeochemistry).
relevance_note: Candidate carbon-cycle component for F5 if a COPSE-type model is not used; cGENIE with a land-weathering scheme can be run on Palaeozoic configurations generated with muffingen. EPRP holds no run outputs for the window other than Balembois's. [relevance: extractor's inference]

citation: muffingen, Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.13377220 (v0.24-574-NSF; v0.9.24 of January 2023 also mirrored)
what_it_contains: cGENIE boundary-condition generator (MATLAB).
relevance_note: Would build cGENIE grids and boundary conditions from the PaleoDEMs or plate models listed here for 485-383 Ma time slices. [relevance: extractor's inference]

what_it_contains: TREED model code and outputs for the PETM (Apache 2.0); 15.6 GB, indexed only (not mirrored).
relevance_note: Worked output of the vegetation model for a warming event; fetch only if the TREED code is adopted. [relevance: extractor's inference]

citation: Smith et al. 2023, Glob. Ecol. Biogeogr., doi:10.1111/geb.13735
what_it_contains: BioDeepTime database (7.4 million rows; CSV, Parquet, SQLite, RDS) and compilation bundle with BioTIME, Neotoma, Triton and PBDB source exports. Contains PBDB records that PBDB now withholds (EPRP flag).
relevance_note: Time-series compilation across sources; useful only if a compilation-level observation model is built from existing databases. No Palaeozoic plants (inference). [relevance: extractor's inference]

citation: Currano et al. 2021, Palaeogeogr. Palaeoclimatol. Palaeoecol., doi:10.1016/j.palaeo.2021.110636 (code deposited by Swain)
what_it_contains: Zip of damage-type matrices for 63 fossil-leaf floras (72,440 leaf rows), network and herbivory metrics and R code.
relevance_note: The only land-plant dataset in the register, but fossil-leaf herbivory in post-Palaeozoic floras (inference from the title and EPRP's description; ages not checked); no Silurian-Devonian content. Licence 'other-open' (Zenodo software record), so held under local/. [relevance: extractor's inference]

what_it_contains: CONOP bundle (Windows executable, configuration, event, section and load files: 3,058 events in 278 sections) and R code; the occurrence data are in the Dryad deposit. Contains a Windows executable, do not run.
relevance_note: Constrained-optimisation range-chart method for sparse, section-based records: a possible alternative route to composite first-appearance times for Silurian-Devonian spore and plant records. [relevance: extractor's inference]

what_it_contains: Data S1 (8,743 section rows and a table of contents) and Data S2 (figure source data).
relevance_note: Companion to the CONOP bundle: the section-by-taxon occurrence format such a compilation needs. [relevance: extractor's inference]

citation: Tsuboi et al. 2024, J. Evol. Biol., doi:10.1093/jeb/voae103
what_it_contains: R code and 28 trait time series, each in two forms.
relevance_note: Null expectations for rates of trait evolution against interval length when a size series (F2) is compared with simulation. [relevance: extractor's inference]
